reuse.why: The rule is changed inside the existing getRangeAmount and getPlannedAmount helpers, which getScheduledAmount and every server and UI site already call.

duplication.why: Nothing is copied; both edited branches get simpler (Math.min, amount - threshold).

placement.why: The edit stays in shared/schedules.ts, where the tree centralises planned schedule amounts.

scope.why: Only the two helpers, their comments and their tests change.

maintainability.why: A minimal change to the single shared definition, with tests extended to income, entry order and zero-spanning ranges.
